description: This file is a PHP script that generates a webpage for managing LAN Ethernet ports on a network gateway device. It includes logic for retrieving and displaying Ethernet port status, speeds, and configurations, as well as handling user interactions for enabling/disabling ports and associating a specific port with a home security network. The file also contains embedded JavaScript for dynamic UI behavior and AJAX calls to perform configuration changes.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if Ethernet port 4 is enabled for XFINITY Home Security network, based on device configuration parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps Ethernet port status strings to user-friendly status labels, considering device settings for WAN modes.
